As at September 30, 2026, the Company has hedged approximately 46.0 Mbbls/d of expected oil and condensate production and 736 MMcf/d of expected natural gas production for the remainder of the year.
During the third quarter of 2026, the Company invested $563 million, which was in line with its third quarter guidance range of $550 million to $600 million.
The Company expects to meet its full year 2026 capital investment guidance range of $2,250 million to $2,350 million.

In November 2026, the Company updated its other NGLs guidance range and expects to meet its full year 2026 total production guidance range of 630.0 MBOE/d to 645.0 MBOE/d, including oil and plant condensate production volumes of approximately 210.0 Mbbls/d to 212.0 Mbbls/d, other NGLs production volumes of approximately 85.0 Mbbls/d to 87.0 Mbbls/d and natural gas production volumes of approximately 2,025 MMcf/d…

The Company is on track to incur upstream transportation and processing costs of approximately $8.75 per BOE to $9.25 per BOE, upstream operating expenses of approximately $3.00 per BOE to $3.50 per BOE, and total production, mineral and other taxes of approximately 3.25 to 3.75 percent of upstream product revenues for the remainder of the year.
Additional information on Ovintiv’s fourth quarter and updated full year 2026 Corporate Guidance can be accessed on the Company’s website at www.ovintiv.com .
The report highlights the Company’s 2025 sustainability results, and its progress in emissions intensity reductions with the goal to meet its Scope 1&2 GHG emissions target by 2030.
As at the end of 2025, the Company had achieved 85 percent of its Scope 1&2 GHG emissions intensity reduction target of 50 percent by 2030, measured against the 2019 baseline.
Ovintiv remains committed to its GHG emissions reduction target and has tied the target to the Company’s annual compensation program for all employees.
Acquisitions are assessed and evaluated for environmental impacts and alignment with the Company’s GHG emissions intensity target.

Completion of the Logan Acquisition is subject to conditions that may not be satisfied or completed on a timely basis or at all, and, if completed, we may be unable to achieve the anticipated benefits of the Logan Acquisition.

If the Logan Acquisition is not completed, we will be required to pay our costs relating to the Logan Acquisition, such as legal, accounting and financial advisory expenses, and we will have committed management time and resources to the transaction, in each case without realizing any of the benefits of having completed the Logan Acquisition.

If the Logan Acquisition is completed, our ability to achieve its anticipated benefits will depend in part upon whether we can integrate the assets and their operations into our existing business in an efficient and effective manner.

estimates.t: There have been no significant changes to the Company’s critical accounting policies and use of estimates from the disclosures reported in the Critical Accounting Estimates section of the MD&A included in Item 7 of the 2025 Annual Report on Form 10‑K.

estimates.name: Cash from Operating Activities and Non-GAAP Cash Flow
estimates.t: Non-GAAP Cash Flow is a non-GAAP measure defined as cash from (used in) operating activities excluding net change in other assets and liabilities, and net change in non-cash working capital.

estimates.name: Debt to Capitalization and Debt to Adjusted Capitalization
estimates.t: Debt to Adjusted Capitalization is a non-GAAP measure which adjusts capitalization for historical ceiling test impairments that were recorded as at December 31, 2011.

estimates.name: Debt to EBITDA and Debt to Adjusted EBITDA
estimates.t: Debt to EBITDA and Debt to Adjusted EBITDA are non-GAAP measures.

estimates.name: Item 3: Quantitative and Qualitati ve Disclosures About Market Risk
estimates.t: The primary objective of the following information is to provide forward-looking quantitative and qualitative information about Ovintiv’s potential exposure to market risks.

estimates.name: COMMODITY PRICE RISK
estimates.t: Commodity price risk arises from the effect that fluctuations in future commodity prices, including oil, NGLs and natural gas, may have on future revenues, expenses and cash flows.

estimates.name: FOREIGN EXCHANGE RISK
estimates.t: As Ovintiv operates primarily in the United States and Canada, fluctuations in the exchange rate between the U.S. and Canadian dollars can have a significant effect on the Company’s reported results.

estimates.name: U.S. dollar denominated financing debt issued from Canada — U.S. dollar denominated risk m
estimates.t: To partially mitigate the effect of foreign exchange fluctuations on future commodity revenues and expenses, the Company may enter into foreign currency derivative contracts from time to time.

estimates.name: INTEREST RATE RISK
estimates.t: Interest rate risk arises from changes in market interest rates that may affect the fair value or future cash flows from the Company’s financial assets or liabilities.

estimates.name: Item 4: Controls and Procedures — DISCLOSURE CONTROLS AND PROCEDURES
estimates.t: Ovintiv’s Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer performed an evaluation of the effectiveness of the Company’s disclosure controls and procedures as defined in Rules 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e) of the Exchange Act.

estimates.name: CHANGES IN INTERNAL CONTROL OVER FINANCIAL REPORTING
estimates.t: For the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, management’s assessment of, and conclusion on, the effectiveness of internal controls over financial reporting did not include the internal controls related to the NuVista Energy Ltd. acquisition that closed on February 3, 2026.
